hypothesis: Analysis closer to the regular open can reduce the execution difference introduced by an early premarket fill, while remaining a genuinely premarket analysis.
primary_route: fixed SOXX 20-completed-session return >0 selects SOXL, else SOXS; missing/stale data or existing position -> no new action
model_training: No fitting, per-month hindsight switching or changed trend lookback
entry: Same causal next-bar rule as v2: strictly after decision+30s. 09:25:30 maps to 09:30, never to the already-completed 09:25 bar.
take_profit_and_expiry: Unchanged v2 attached +5% GTC RTH limit and inclusive 14-calendar-day expiry with forced sell; preserve all losses
capital_and_costs: Unchanged v2 continuous one-position settled-cash ledger and fixed costs
primary_metric: User-confirmed arithmetic mean of net capital-ledger returns in 2026-05, 2026-07 and 2026-09
cost_stress: Repeat the fixed primary action policy with commissions and slippage doubled, without changing predictions or entry decisions
evaluation_status: Historical development; months and prior baseline outcomes already exposed. A numerical gate pass is not independent prospective proof.
other_requirements: Any timestamp analysis uses the same causal feature function; scheduled 09:25 replay is the registered effect evaluation frequency, not a restriction on launching analysis. No actual broker orders.
